port.description: TCP port on which the MacTelnet daemon listens

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed

pidfile.description: Absolute path to the PID file for the daemon process

tls_private_key.description: Absolute path to the private key file (leave empty to disable TLS)

tls_certificate.description: Absolute path to the TLS certificate file (required if TLS is enabled)

allowed_macs.description: List of allowed client MAC addresses (if empty, all MACs permitted)

session_timeout.description: Idle session timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout)

root_dir.description: Root directory visible to authenticated clients (use with caution)

users.description: List of authorized users (required for authentication)

password.description: Password (plaintext — consider hashing in future versions)

gid.description: Optional GID for file access permissions
